message.content:
Black wool cape coat, classic straight cut, knee length, deep black (#000000), heavy woven wool.
Crimson silk blouse, relaxed fit with a rounded neckline, hip length, muted red (#5d0218), smooth satin silk.
Charcoal gray fine-gauge knit skirt, A-line silhouette, mid-calf length, dark charcoal (#36454f), merino wool.
Oxford black lace-up shoes, cap-toe design, ankle height, true black (#1a1a1a), full-grain leather.
Simple matte black pearl stud earrings, round shape, 6mm diameter, #000000, cultured freshwater pearls set in sterling silver.
A single white carnation pinned to the lapel.

This outfit honors the solemnity of a grandpa's funeral with appropriate darkness and texture while respecting the autumn season. The charcoal skirt provides a respectful step away from solid black to reflect personal warmth, balanced by the rich crimson blouse that adds life without being distracting. A practical wool cape offers necessary protection against cool fall weather while maintaining a dignified silhouette. The classic lace-up shoes ensure comfort for walking during the service, and the single white flower serves as a quiet, traditional tribute to the deceased.
